title: Mazloom Sakina Masoom  Sakina
body:
Kaheti Thi Tadapkar Shabbir Ki Duqtar
Pas Apne Muje Ab Bulwao Baba
Zinda Ka Andhera Ek Bibi Ka Nouha
Hain Zulm Musalsal De Kaun Dilasa
<<DIVIDER>>
Tha Mera Bichouna Baba Tera Sina
Ab Soun Main Kaise Ajao Baba
Marjaongi Pyasi Maagungi Na Paani
Ammu Ko Bulao Main Hogayee Tanha
<<DIVIDER>>
Ro Bhi Nhi Sakti Soo Bhi Nahi sakti
Kanou Se Abhi Tak Hai Khoon Tapakta
Khati Hu Tamache Ruksar hai Neele
Dekho Tho Ammu Kya Haal Hai Mera
<<DIVIDER>>
Dushwar Hai Jeena Dam Ghut-Ta Hai Mera
Gardan Ki Rassi Ko Khulwao Baba
Zainab Ne Di Sada Qaliq Ki Duhai
Abbbas Kaha Ho Marti ai Sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
Zanjeer Me Jakde Abid Hai Tadapte
Ek Bhai Pa Kaisa Ye Waqt Hai Aaya
Bechain Hai Bhai Gurbat Aur Tanhayi
Dam Tod-Rahi Hai Ab Pyasi Sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
Iss Qaid-e-Sitam Ka Manzar Kaise
Dafan Kaise Karu Hai Andhera
